recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-17326 unless a future terminology issue intentionally revises the conflict wording.
issue_request: FHIR-17326 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from STU3 asking that the issue-type `conflict` description say an edit conflict is normally HTTP 409, not HTTP 404.
initial_application: The Jira record says the requested correction was applied in svn revision 14454. No modern Git commit is explicitly tagged FHIR-17326, but current Git history shows the modern source rework already carried the corrected HTTP 409 text and later cleanup preserved it.
additional_context: OperationOutcome is active in source/fhir.ini as a current resource and special resource. The issue-type ValueSet composes all codes from http://hl7.org/fhir/issue-type, so the ValueSet page uses the authoritative CodeSystem definition. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or more recent community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative CodeSystem definition for `conflict` already says the pure RESTful equivalent is HTTP 409, and a source search found no conflict definition that still uses HTTP 404.
